name: Ordinary approach within original activation range then harvest second Cairn06a05f

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1;if frames<30 or frames%5~=0 then return end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Cairn Bolete harvest')
 local t=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6a05f));assert(t and t:isValid(),'Original second Cairn missing')
 print('CairnHarvest stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6251e))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(t:getBoundingBox().center)
 if v:length()<=140 then print('CairnHarvest within range') end
 local yaw=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z);local pitch=-math.atan2(v.y,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.025 and math.abs(pitch)<.025 then print('CairnHarvest facing second') end
 print(string.format('CairnHarvest look x=%d y=%d range=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5))),v:length()))
end}}}}
